stories.title: Gerald D. Ash (July 23, 1943 — September 28, 2026)
stories.summary: Mr. Gerald D. Ash passed away at his home in Irondale on September 28, 2026. He was 83. “Mr. Jerry” was a lifelong resident of Birmingham.
